motivation: The merged recovery pathway shows that Thalassia is re-recorded more often when seagrass habitat remains occupied after focal loss, while the within-node audit tests how much of that is broad site quality. This hypothesis asks whether a point's own pre-loss Thalassia persistence history contains an additional local legacy signal.

source.recovery_sequence: same exact three-year sequence definition as results/microsite_recovery_pathway_v1_contract.json

exposure.name: preloss_thalassia_streak_years
exposure.definition: Number of consecutive calendar years with consensus Thalassia presence at the same stable point ending in source year t immediately before the frozen t+1 loss. Walk backward one calendar year at a time and stop at the first absence or unobserved/non-consensus year.

primary_design.population: same frozen three-year exact-point loss sequences as microsite_recovery_pathway_v1
primary_design.informative_stratum: within a node × intermediate-state stratum, at least one t+2 Thalassia return and at least one non-return
primary_design.stratum_effect: mean pre-loss streak among return sequences minus mean pre-loss streak among non-return sequences
primary_design.node_effect: unweighted mean of informative stratum effects within each node
primary_design.estimator: unweighted mean node effect across informative nodes
primary_design.support_rule: 95% bootstrap interval for mean within-node/within-intermediate-state streak difference entirely above zero

secondary_descriptive: return fraction by exact integer streak length where n>=10, descriptive only

interpretation.supported: Longer exact-point pre-loss Thalassia persistence is associated with subsequent re-recording even after controlling by stable transect and loss-year vegetation class, consistent with a local legacy/persistence signal.
interpretation.unsupported: Pre-loss exact-point persistence history does not add a robust within-node/within-loss-state legacy signal for subsequent re-recording.

claim_boundary: Post-hoc exploratory temporal ecology on an already-opened exact-point panel.
A pre-loss streak association cannot identify residual rhizomes, clonal integration, habitat quality, or observation/detection persistence separately.
Return remains re-recorded Thalassia at the same meter mark, not proven recolonization.
Do not dichotomize or retune streak length after opening results.
Do not change the frozen recovery sequence, node/intermediate-state stratification, equal-node estimator, bootstrap unit, or minimum informative-node rule after opening the endpoint.
